Variations

This item can be obtained in the following variations. The 'fine' consumable can be cooked by using all fine material ingredients or may be found from chests where it can replace a normal drop with a fixed rate of 1/100

Primary Recipe Output

Brew saltrum

After cleaning and preparing the kelp, you begin the fermentation process in a wooden cask, adding yeast and water. With patience, you tend to the mixture, allowing it to transform into a rich, alcoholic beverage.

A strong brew crafted from the sweet essence of kelp, fermented to perfection. Rich, complex flavors with a hint of ocean breeze.
